headlines.description: — Joc Pederson homered twice to drive in four runs and Ezequiel Duran and Jake Burger also went deep for the Texas Rangers in a 7-3 victory over the Seattle Mariners on Monday. They took three of four in the series to stretch their AL West lead to 2...
headlines.shortLinkText: Joc Pederson hits first 2 of Rangers' 4 homers in 7-3 win over Mariners to take key AL West series

headlines.description: — Brandon Lowe singled home Billy Cook in the bottom of the 10th inning to rally the Pittsburgh Pirates to a 3-2 win over the Arizona Diamondbacks on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Brandon Lowe’s 10th-inning hit rallies the Pirates over the Diamondbacks 3-2

headlines.description: — Jackson Holliday had four hits and the Baltimore Orioles hit three home runs in an 8-5 win against the Detroit Tigers on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Holliday's 4 hits, Orioles' 3 homers leads to an 8-5 victory over the Tigers

headlines.description: — Griffin Conine hit a walkoff run-scoring single to lift the Marlins past the Philadelphia Phillies 8-7 on Monday and end Miami's franchise record 12-game losing streak.
headlines.shortLinkText: Griffin Conine’s walk-off RBI single snaps the Marlins’ 12-game skid with an 8-7 win over Phillies

events.name: Toronto Blue Jays at Washington Nationals

headlines.description: — Luis Urías homered, Myles Straw had a double and a run-scoring single, and the Toronto Blue Jays celebrated Max Scherzer's return to Washington with a 3-2 win over the Nationals on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Urías homers and Blue Jays beat Nationals 3-2 in Scherzer's return to Washington

headlines.description: — The opening game of the three-game series between the Cleveland Guardians and Reds in Cincinnati was postponed Monday night due to rain.
headlines.shortLinkText: Guardians-Reds game in Cincinnati postponed due to rain; day-night doubleheader set for Tuesday

events.name: Atlanta Braves at New York Mets

headlines.description: — Francisco Lindor homered twice and tripled off the top of the fence, driving in six runs as the New York Mets pulled away for a 14-3 victory over the Atlanta Braves on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Francisco Lindor homers twice and drives in 6 as Mets pull away for 14-3 rout of Braves

events.name: New York Yankees at Chicago White Sox

headlines.description: — Ali Sánchez hit a three-run shot for his first career homer and the New York Yankees beat the Chicago White Sox 9-5 on Monday night in the opener of a four-game series between playoff contenders.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ali Sánchez hits his 1st career homer as the Yankees beat the White Sox 9-5

events.name: Chicago Cubs at St. Louis Cardinals

headlines.description: — Alex Bregman had a homer, two doubles and drove in two runs to lead the Chicago Cubs to a 7-3 win over the St. Louis Cardinals on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Bregman breaks out of slump with a HR, 2 doubles as the Cubs beat the Cardinals 7-3

events.name: Houston Astros at Los Angeles Angels

headlines.description: — LaMonte Wade Jr. drew a bases-loaded walk that forced home the go-ahead run in a four-run ninth inning, and the Houston Astros came back to beat the Los Angeles Angels 6-4 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Astros take advantage of Angels meltdown to score 4 runs in 9th inning for 6-4 win

events.name: Boston Red Sox at Athletics Athletics

headlines.description: — Ceddanne Rafaela hit his first major league grand slam and the Boston Red Sox beat the Athletics 4-2 after being held without a hit through five innings Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Ceddanne Rafaela's grand slam sends Red Sox past A's 4-2 for 18th victory in 20 games

events.name: Milwaukee Brewers at San Francisco Giants

headlines.description: — Grant McCray hit his first major league home run in almost two years and Tyler Mahle pitched into the seventh inning as the San Francisco Giants beat the Milwaukee Brewers 3-0 on Monday night.
headlines.shortLinkText: Grant McCray's 2-run homer backs Tyler Mahle and leads the Giants to a 3-0 win over the Brewers
